answer: An operator that abandons 181 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the spiral forfeiture publishes up in the ocean totals with the wander audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 13% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
